paras: The Papuan logrunner or New Guinea logrunner (Orthonyx novaeguineae) is a species of bird in the family Orthonychidae. It was formerly considered conspecific with the Australian logrunner.
It is found in the highlands of New Guinea. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist montane forests.
